item.description:
### Risky Words is yours now, with your own word list
The risky-word guard used to be something only an organisation could switch on. On a personal Mac it is now your own: turn it on from the Home screen, see how many words are being shielded, and add your own on top of the built-in list. Words you add stay on this Mac.
### Uninstall Protection has its own card on Home
It was a row near the bottom of the Home screen, which meant most people never found it. It now sits on the Home grid beside Risky Words, showing at a glance whether it is on, pending, or needs attention — and tapping it opens the same screen as before.
### Clearer wording: it protects Kahf Guard, not every app
The screen said "Apps cannot be uninstalled". On a Mac it only ever protected Kahf Guard itself — every other app on your Mac can be removed normally. The wording now says so.
